title: Sirloin Steak with Pan-Seared Quenelles
description: A classic steak dish paired with crispy pan-seared quenelles, perfect for a quick dinner.
instructions: Preheat the skillet over high heat.
Season the sirloin steak with salt and pepper.
Sear the steak in the hot skillet for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired temperature.
Transfer the steak to a plate and let it rest.
Heat the saudi oil in the skillet over medium heat.
Add the quenelles and pan-fry until golden brown and crispy.
Serve the steak with the pan-seared quenelles.
